newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SELLS STAKES IN FINANCIAL FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SELLS STAKES IN FINANCIAL FIRMS.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Tuesday it had decided to sell its 34.2 percent stake in specialised bank Mendes Gans to ING .
Its fully-owned unit Philips Financial Services Ltd will be sold to Britains Avco Trust Ltd in a separate deal.
"The total positive cashflow from these disinvestments will be more than 200 million guilders," Philips said in a statement.
It added that it had decided to sell the units to concentrate on its strategic and financial core activities.
In a separate statement, ING said the purchase of the 34.2 percent stake in Mendes Gans had increased its interest in this firm to 93.3 percent.
Mendes Gans is a wholesale bank which provides financial services to multinational companies and institutional investors.
